summary: Surveyed all 231 listed Lean files (HexConway, HexRank, HexResultantMathlib) with sizes and a line-start declaration grep (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, allowing attribute and private/noncomputable/meta modifiers). 226 files have at least one declaration. The 5 zero-declaration files (HexConway/Api.lean, Certificates.lean, PrimeFactors.lean, Primitivity.lean, Table.lean) were read completely: each is a module of public imports plus set_option maxRecDepth/maxHeartbeats and empty Hex.Conway namespace blocks, so they are not pure-import files under FILTER-007 and in any case FILTER-007 keeps import aggregators primary-eligible. The large generated-looking Entries/Rabin/Transport/Supported files hold real declarations (Conway polynomial defs with monicity, degree, lookup, irreducibility theorems). No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar; all are retained.
